name: card-hover-effect
title: Card Hover Effect
blurb: Grid of cards with a smooth border glow on hover.
description: Grid component that renders cards from an items array. Each card has title, description, and link. Hover effect adds a glowing border. Uses a smooth easing for the glow animation.
use_when: Project showcases, service grids, or link collections where hover feedback adds polish.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces — hover effects don't apply.
a11y: Links are semantic. Cards are readable. Focus state should match hover for keyboard users.
